issues.title: Ruler label and tick collision
issues.description: The timestamp marker text overlaps the vertical ruler tick line.
issues.evidence: The '01:50' text collides with the vertical marker line on the timeline.
issues.suggestion: Add vertical clearance between ruler tick lines and time labels.
issues.triageNote: Verified: the line crossing the '01:50' label is the eval page's own full-height overlay (selection band border-x border-brand-primary/50 at left-2664px + destructive marker line), not a ruler tick — the component's major ticks are h-3 bottom-anchored (top at y=22) while labels sit at bottom-[16px] (ink y≈8–18), leaving 4px clearance; no component defect.

issues.title: Inconsistent tick indicator symbol
issues.description: The intermediate marker uses an asterisk character instead of a standard ruler tick.
issues.evidence: An asterisk appears at the midpoint between 00:00 and 00:10 ticks.
issues.suggestion: Render standard vertical tick marks consistently across the ruler.
issues.triageNote: The ◆ event markers are an intentional documented feature, not stray ticks, but the 6px text glyph is illegible at marker size (auditor read 'asterisk'; independent VLM read saw 'dot/short tick' — nobody sees a diamond), so the shape itself is the defect; replaced the glyph spans with crisp rotate-45 CSS diamonds at identical positions/size/color.

issues.title: Awkward text wrapping
issues.description: The helper metadata wraps awkwardly onto a second line at 360px width.
issues.evidence: The phrase 'to pan' wraps alone to a new line at the card bottom.
issues.suggestion: Shorten label copy or reduce font size to maintain a single line.
issues.triageNote: The wrapping helper caption ('◆ 11 review comments · last viewed 00:05 · swipe to pan') is eval-page chrome — the component renders no captions; hardened the component demo's own caption to wrap at separator boundaries so the same pattern can't orphan words.

issues.title: Orphan text wrap in legend
issues.description: Legend description wraps with a single orphan word on the second line.
issues.evidence: The word 'pan' sits alone on the final line in the ruler footer.
issues.suggestion: Adjust container padding or reduce legend font size to fit in one line.
issues.triageNote: Same pattern as pair-094: the orphaning legend ('◆ deploy markers · major tick 10 s · swipe to pan') is eval-page text outside the component; demo caption hardening covers the analogous in-repo instance.
